OpsBot: Incident channel opened for hosted-inference timeouts in ap-south, severity=P2. Runbook: https://redwood/runbooks/hosted-timeouts :rotating_light:
Jenna (Support): multiple CS tickets and a zoom with ACME. Customers seeing 502/504s and very high p99 latency on /v1/generate endpoints. Started ~22:10 UTC, spike during a batch at 22:08.
Samir Khan (Oncall): looking. Are these across all models or a single endpoint?
Jenna (Support): customer report says 'all endpoints' but support observed it mostly on rwd-xl and guest-structured-chat.
Alice Chen (Eng - Runtime): pulling metrics now. Early hypothesis: KV cache warmup evictions plus autoscaler flapping causing queueing.
Mateo Ruiz (Infra): noticed redis auth errors around same window, 22:07-22:12 UTC. Possible auth retries spiking the proxy.
Priya Patel (SRE): enabling extra verbosity on ingress proxies, turning on debug sampling. Can we throttle retries at client proxy?
Samir Khan (Oncall): yes adding a temporary 2s backoff and dropping immediate retries for 30m.
Jenna (Support): Customer-facing note drafted, Claire can you review? Claire O'Neill (CS): on it, will send by EOD for affected tenants.
Alice Chen (Eng - Runtime): digging into runtime logs: snippet:
```
2024-11-09T22:08:13Z runtime ERROR request_id=abc123 stage=kv_fetch err="connection reset by peer"
2024-11-09T22:08:14Z runtime WARN model=rwd-xl kv_miss=true seq_len=1024 queue_wait_ms=4800
2024-11-09T22:08:15Z proxy ERROR 502 upstream_status=504 upstream_resp_time_ms=12034
```
Samir Khan (Oncall): those queue_wait_ms look bad. Are we seeing batch size spikes?
Alice Chen (Eng - Runtime): yes, sudden surge of requests with long seq_len caused oversized batches; compilation path slowed, kv cache thrashing.
Mateo Ruiz (Infra): redis auth retry errors are causing small window of unavailability — ops team rolled a fix at 22:18 that stabilized connections.
Priya Patel (SRE): mitigation checklist run: scaled up edge pool by +2 nodes, applied retry backoff, disabled one noisy customer route temporarily. Latency p95 down from 2.2s to 0.6s.
Jenna (Support): CS confirmed the main customers are acknowledging improvement. Still monitoring for regression.
Samir Khan (Oncall): short term actions done. Need postmortem and action items.
Alice Chen (Eng - Runtime): proposed immediate follow-ups:
- add guardrail to limit batch unfolding when seq_len > 1024
- KV cache pre-warm heuristics for large models
- add better telemetry for batch size distribution per-tenancy
(assigned: Alice)
Mateo Ruiz (Infra): infra follow-ups:
- investigate redis auth flaps and central KMS token rotation window (assigned: Mateo)
- increase grace concurrency for proxy during auth rotation (assigned: Mateo + Priya)
Priya Patel (SRE): operational follow-ups:
- circuit-breaker to shed noisy tenant traffic earlier (assigned: Priya)
- autoscaler smoothing window tweak to avoid flapping (assigned: Priya + Alice)
Claire O'Neill (CS): comms follow-ups:
- finalize customer incident emails and post on status page (assigned: Claire)
- prepare template for after-hours CS escalation (assigned: Claire + Jenna)
Samir Khan (Oncall): Can we add quick repro steps for eng to trigger locally? Jenna, can support share a snippet of customer traffic (sanitized)?
Jenna (Support): shared sanitized sample payload in private thread. Example client usage:
```bash
curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer <redacted>" -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"model":"rwd-xl","prompt":"<long prompt>","max_tokens":2048}'
```
Alice Chen (Eng - Runtime): I'll create a small harness that replays that traffic shape (long seq_len, concurrent clients).
Samir Khan (Oncall): timeline for follow-ups?
Alice Chen (Eng - Runtime): PRs for batch guardrails and telemetry this week (ETA: 72h).
Mateo Ruiz (Infra): redis/KMS investigation complete by end of week (ETA: 5 days).
Priya Patel (SRE): autoscaler smoothing and CB config change next 48h, will canary in ap-south.
Claire O'Neill (CS): customer comms sent, status.redwood updated, CS follow-up scheduled tomorrow.
Jenna (Support): ACME confirmed degraded but acceptable after mitigations, will reopen if anything else.
Samir Khan (Oncall): action items captured. I'll own the postmortem doc and link logs; assigning owners accordingly. Please paste PR/issue links here when created.
OpsBot: Reminder set: postmortem sync in #incidents at 2024-11-11 15:00 UTC.
Alice Chen (Eng - Runtime): quick note — example runtime metric we should track: per-model kv_miss_rate, batch_size_percentile(95), seq_len_histogram. Adding to telemetry backlog.
Mateo Ruiz (Infra): adding redis auth rotation jitter and monitoring to infra playbook.
Priya Patel (SRE): will run chaos test for KMS flaps in staging to validate proxy behavior.
Claire O'Neill (CS): adding customer comm follow-up to CS runbook.
Samir Khan (Oncall): thanks team. Closing channel after postmortem. If anyone sees regression ping @samir. :thumbsup:
